what.text: This page follows refugees from Sri Lanka living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3195 Sri Lankan refugees in Germany, 2.2% of all refugees from Sri Lanka.
India hosts the most Sri Lankan refugees, followed by France, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Eelam territory in Sri Lanka with the LTTE in periods from 1997 to 2009, at war level in most of those years.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005 and 2009 to 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at its highest figure, 17403 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
